doc.title: cry-biped
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hostile biped creature gives one low guttural battle growl. No human words. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-bird
doc.body: Sound effect only: A wild bird gives two short piercing chirps, natural and lively. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-crag
doc.body: Sound effect only: A stone creature gives one deep grinding bellow, rock-on-rock texture and falling grit. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-crawler
doc.body: Sound effect only: A large crawler gives one rasping hiss and chitter, close and unsettling. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-flier
doc.body: Sound effect only: A large flying creature gives one short rough aerial screech and wing rustle. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-hopper
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hostile hopping creature gives one sharp throaty bark with a short trill. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-quadruped
doc.body: Sound effect only: A wild four-legged beast gives one throaty growl with a short snarl, canine rather than feline. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-serpent
doc.body: Sound effect only: A serpent gives one long breathy hiss that tapers off, no roar. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-slime
doc.body: Sound effect only: A gelatinous slime gives one wet burbling call and low wobbling squeak. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-wisp
doc.body: Sound effect only: A floating wisp gives one thin spectral ascending call, airy and brief. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-biped
doc.body: Sound effect only: One firm biped creature footfall on soil: heavier than a person, short dull thud. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-bird
doc.body: Sound effect only: One small bird hop on earth: tiny tap and soft feather shuffle. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-crag
doc.body: Sound effect only: One stone creature footfall: dense rocky knock, grit and a short low rumble. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-crawler
doc.body: Sound effect only: One many-legged crawler movement on dirt: quick small taps and a dry scrape. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-flier
doc.body: Sound effect only: One flying creature movement: a compact flap of leathery wings through air. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-hopper
doc.body: Sound effect only: One small hopping creature landing: springy light thump and brief settling rustle. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-quadruped
doc.body: Sound effect only: One padded four-legged beast paw landing on soil: soft low thump with a little claw scrape. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-serpent
doc.body: Sound effect only: One serpent slithering movement: dry scales and earth brushing under the body. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-slime
doc.body: Sound effect only: One gelatinous slime movement: low wet squelch with a tiny bubble pop. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-wisp
doc.body: Sound effect only: One floating wisp movement: very brief airy shimmer rather than a footfall. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: wolf
doc.body: Sound effect only: A grey wolf gives a nasal bark, then a teeth-baring growl and a short mournful yowl. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.
